items.text: Find every place a host's name is shown to guests
Server: stop sending a host's last name on guest-facing payloads (stay page, guest reviews, inbox, automated messages)
Client: render first name only on the stay page, guest inbox/thread and review author lines
Update the guest-review test and add a test proving no host last name leaks
Verify in the browser and via the API, run lint/build/tests, commit and push
